Dear Anthony: I am  surprised that you don't know the difference between  inquisition   and ACQUISITION !!! Has the  FREE PRESS done away with copy editors in an effoirt to save a few bucks? Check your column of Dec. 17 about Avila not speaking for the owner. I suggest you buy a  dictionary AND USE  IT or at least check it for boo boo's when in  doubt. There is a vast world of difference between these two words as you will discover, I hope.
VAUGHN   HOOIGASIAN ( ONE TIME  JOURALLISM  AND   ENGLISH TEACHER )
